workspace.title: Project Status

sections.intent: Client sees the project name, reporting period, and overall status at a glance.
Client reads the AI-generated narrative summary covering tasks, time, materials, and delay risks.
Client reviews structured breakdowns of tasks, time logs, materials, and delay risk assessment.
Client reads the project manager's notes and confirms when the report was generated and shared.

workspace.purpose: Client reviews the shared project status report to stay informed on progress and budget.

presentation.classificationNote: This workspace is a pure read-only view of a single StatusReport record for an external stakeholder (client). There are no write operations whatsoever — only a single 'view' query. The summary-first layout with structured overviews and PM notes is a textbook match for readOnlyDetailPortal.

alternates.reason: The report contains AI-generated content, but the client only reads it — there is no generate/review/publish cycle on this workspace.
